text1: The station called the Shattered Ring has been built through the largest surviving arc of an ancient adamantine megastructure. Habitats, docks, revival wards, and salvage gantries cling to the fracture like barnacles. The surrounding debris is divided into jealously guarded orbital claims known as wreck-farms. Generations of salvagers have worked these plots, drawing metals, machinery, intact hull sections, and the occasional living cryopod from a field that has never quite run dry.

A silent transit terminus rises inward from a remote district of the Dyson sphere's shell. Passenger concourses and cargo spines stand empty, but a sealed continuity archive remains alive behind the station's inner bulkheads.

A solitary adamantine Power Transit Gate floating at the center of a starless system near the northeastern edge of the Sector. No stable jump point leads there; its hazy purple nascent gravity well can be entered only by Transverse Jump. Its coordinates were reconstructed from the synchronized routing vectors hidden in both Coronal Hypershunts. The Gate points beyond ordinary hyperspace geometry, toward the sealed interior called Gan Eden.
Some incredibly high-powered energy blasted a hole through Gan Eden's shell from the outside in.

A surveyed settlement anchor built directly into Gan Eden's inner shell. Its boundaries follow permanent terrain, utility, and load-bearing districts in the megastructure; it is a fixed surface location, not a separate world.
A vast coherent rift projected as a blade of annihilating light. The stresses required to focus it leave its bearer almost incapable of maneuvering.
